BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Pocahontas Parkway Operations, LLC operates the long-term tolled-road concession south of Richmond, Virginia. The manager-level platform includes the 8.8-mile Pocahontas Parkway, its James River crossing, tolling systems and the 1.58-mile Richmond Airport Connector; bridges, ramps, plazas and financing vehicles remain components rather than separate PortCos. Globalvia completed its acquisition on December 20, 2016 and currently reports a 68.14% stake. Northleaf joined as a direct co-investor in 2017 and remains active; its exact ownership percentage is not publicly disclosed. No later equity sale or signed pending transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.

STORY TIMELINE
2017
Investment

Northleaf made a direct co-investment alongside Globalvia in Pocahontas Parkway.

Dec 20, 2016
Investment

Globalvia completed its acquisition of the Pocahontas Parkway concession.

Jun 29, 2006

Virginia's 99-year concession for the Parkway and airport connector transferred to the private concession company.

2002
Expansion

The toll road opened to traffic in stages.

1998
Expansion

Construction began on the Pocahontas Parkway project.

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Ascension FBO Network is an 11-location U.S. fixed-base operator platform that provides aircraft fueling, hangaring, ground handling and passenger and crew services for business and general aviation, with selected airline and military support. The platform was formed as Hawthorne Global Aviation Services in 2011 and adopted the Ascension commercial brand during 2025. NOVA Infrastructure and Wafra completed their joint acquisition on March 15, 2022 through Hawthorne FBO Acquisition Co.; exact economic percentages and Wafra's fund allocation are not publicly disclosed. Individual airport locations, leases and add-on businesses remain beneath the single manager-level platform.
